question: Can a topology-isolated local 3-D swept-void union and deterministic junction-local XY/z correction qualify all 4773 C08 development frames without changing their traversal/frame identities?
method: For each C08 world, construct collision voids from only its sealed graph/splines/radii/FTA. Union only explicitly incident tunnels within fixed local 3-D/node-arc domains; reject non-incident envelope overlap. Extract deterministic SDF boundaries at 0.10/0.05/0.025m, then solve route-local XY/z only after each asset is frozen. Audit every original frame at every resolution.
baseline: The sealed native perception mesh is retained solely for LiDAR and the fixed-XY geometry-first route is rejected. The fallback is to stop, not regenerate Poisson mesh, merge non-incident tunnels, lower thresholds, delete frames or choose a favorable resolution.

user_authorization.scope: Design approval exists; one-shot materialization/trajectory qualification needs separate approval.
user_authorization.confirmation_reference: 2026-08-14 user approved design and implementation preparation only.

acceptance_criteria: Exactly S01/S06/S10, 624 directed traversals and 4773 frame identities are preserved.
All three resolutions preserve provenance/topology isolation and yield watertight, non-degenerate qualifying local surfaces.
All 4773 frames at every resolution pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m, up>=0.8m and frozen continuity limits.
Per-frame pass/fail identity agrees across all resolutions.
Zero LiDAR, M1D/B0 inference, graph, training, C09/C10 or M-TARE reads; complete evidence seal.
stop_conditions: Any source/tool/count drift, non-incident overlap, open/non-manifold surface, resolution disagreement, failed frame or continuity regression.
Any in-run parameter/resolution choice, frame deletion, route reordering, mesh regeneration or forbidden read.
expected_evidence: Input manifest and three resolution-specific collision assets with primitive provenance.
SDF/mesh integrity and non-incident separation reports; complete per-frame clearance and continuity audits.
Corrected trajectories, complete figures, raw log, environment/config snapshot, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
